line.comment: * For all Player-Accepted missions:
* 1. Delete it if the station was destroyed or changed ownership.
* 2. Check the goals and complete it if met.
* 3. Update Mission entries as it progresses.
* 4. Fail it if you can no longer complete it.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Reworked suppression mission.
* Fail if the target changes to an invalid owner or disappears without player attribution.
* Player or neutral ownership is temporarily allowed because boarding and bailing clean up the original target object.
* If it changed ownership and it is not under player or neutral control: fail the mission.
* Target no longer exists: check whether its elimination was attributed to the player.
* Elimination flag is set in Mayhem.Mission.Suppression.Resolve.
* Rescue missions. Expanded 2.2: additional failure condition if crew is lost.
* Fail if the ship or any original crew member is destroyed.
* NPC ownership is allowed because the player can board and recover the ship (M6 and TM only).
* 1. Ship destroyed.
* 2. Any original crew member destroyed.
* Add-Ons 1.4.25: Fix null error. If a suspect (not the stolen ship) no longer exists, then it needs to be removed from the list by forcing a mission update.
* Culprit is dead.
* Just a suspect is dead. Note: don't update PER dead ship all at once; update if a ship in the current array is dead. This will update again if more ships are dead.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Added failure criteria if the player fails to scan at least 50% by the time the station is destroyed.
* Target was destroyed.
* Less than 50% progress: failure.
* At least 50% was completed, but the scan was unfinished: cancel without penalizing the player.
* Target still exists. Until the scan is complete, the target must remain under its original owner.
* Continue scanning.

line.text: 'Scanner ready; stop your ship to continue...'

line.comment: * Once the scan is complete, the intelligence has already been acquired.
* The target station no longer needs to exist.

line.comment: * Mordan8
* Called every 20 seconds, this is used to create up to 2 random missions at a sector that is within a 12 jump radius of the player.
* Prior to this, missions would be created ONLY as a player entered a sector.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Generation chance increased (17% -> 25%) to compensate for the reworked mission generator, which now targets 0-2 missions per sector.
* do it randomly.
* Remove all expired non-accepted missions.
* Stop generating new missions once the galaxy has reached the soft cap.
* A generation pass may exceed this by up to the per-sector generation limit.
* Find an available random sector close to the player.
* If a sector was found, generate missions there.
* Generates up to 2 missions in this sector.
* Find a random player-visible sector within x jumps of the player.
* Ignore player sectors, sectors with no owner. (Add-Ons 1.4.3a: Skip sectors whose owner is in permanent war with the player.)
